title: Change "4 minutes ago" status line to read in seconds
symptom: The status line shows '4 minutes ago' for the time since last reading, which is not precise enough for users who want to know exactly when the next reading will arrive. Users find themselves repeatedly checking the phone when it shows '4 minutes ago' because they don't know the exact seconds remaining.
cause: The thread discusses that the exact time of the next reading is not known for all data sources (e.g., MongoDB or Parakeet), and for some BT devices the timing can vary due to disconnects/reconnects or clock sync issues. The maintainer notes that for G6 with xDrip as collector, the system status page shows scanning only in the last 5-10 seconds before the reading.
fix: The issue was closed without a code change. The maintainer suggests that users can look at a clock with a seconds hand when they see '4 minutes ago' to estimate the next reading, and for G6 collectors, the system status page shows scanning activity in the last seconds before a reading. No specific setting change was implemented.
evidence_quote: Regardless of all of that, all you need is to look at a clock with a seconds hand as soon as you see last connected 4 minutes. Then, looking at that clock, you can tell exactly when to expect the next reading.
